terms.title: QA invented landing-page handoff
terms.description: Invented sandbox project: design a single-page website for a small independent studio. Deliver a wireframe first, then a final handoff. No real customer data.

milestones.title: Wireframe Delivery
milestones.acceptance: Provide one desktop wireframe with introduction, services and contact sections. Buyer checks all three named sections.

milestones.title: Final Handoff
milestones.acceptance: Provide desktop and mobile designs plus a handoff note listing type, colors and spacing. Buyer checks both design sizes and the note.
